detailed_descriptions_html.en:
HELL WAIT is a riichi mahjong roguelike deckbuilder inspired by Balatro, Inscryption, and Buckshot Roulette.

Beat an ever-increasing score target, with your fingers on the line - so try not to deal in.

Features:

  • Over 150 Joker tiles that affect scoring, drawing, and other game rules

  • Enhance your tiles with materials, stickers, and dora

  • Different tile sets to change how you build your deck each run

  • Upgrade yaku using Blessings to turn modest hands into monsters

  • Make dark Pacts to manipulate your tiles and gain the upper hand

  • Mix and match difficulty modifiers for a greater challenge

  • A comprehensive tutorial

No mahjong knowledge required - mechanics like furiten are optional difficulty modifiers, and your opponent will even state his intent. Though he might be lying.
